summary: FAIL: 46 of 69 audited quantitative claim groups have missing evidence, numeric mismatches, config/source mismatches, aggregation errors, or scope overclaims.

claims.paper_text: "1,041-parameter learned support-refinement head"
claims.evidence_value: No parameter-count key for the deployed C2-rel head in supplied JSON/log evidence
claims.details: The paper architecture text internally adds 384+657, but the permitted raw evidence files do not contain a deployed-head parameter count.

claims.location: Abstract lines 17-19; Section1 lines 77-81; Section5 lines 99-100; Section6 lines 141-145
claims.paper_text: "pooled 3-seed reductions -37.7%/-40.2%/-37.6% at SNR in {20,25,30} dB, p<10^-6"
claims.evidence_value: SNR 20: frames=600, classical_errs=3686, learned_errs=2295, delta=-37.737%, p=1.1e-208, SNR 25: frames=773, classical_errs=2209, learned_errs=1322, delta=-40.154%, p=4.75e-134, SNR 30: frames=1300, classical_errs=1160, learned_errs=724, delta=-37.586%, p=2.9e-59
claims.details: Pooled relative changes from classical_errs to learned_errs round to -37.7%, -40.2%, -37.6%; McNemar p-values are all far below 1e-6.

claims.paper_text: "K=16 closes -927% of the physical-support oracle gap at SNR=20 dB versus the head's +81%"
claims.evidence_value: OMP K16 SNR20 gap_closed=-927.136% from OMP file; learned BER=7.393973214285715e-05 from seed 20260425 gives gap_closed=80.976% when combined with OMP file baseline/oracle seed 20260419
claims.details: The K=16 value matches the OMP-extension file, but the learned-head +81% is computed by mixing a different result file, seed, and frame count with the OMP-extension baseline/oracle.

claims.location: Abstract lines 24-25; Section1 lines 71-75; Section3 lines 261-262; Section6 lines 145-146
claims.paper_text: "≈8% analytical MAC overhead at N=1024"
claims.evidence_value: runtime_table.json contains wall-clock rows only, no MAC/frame fields; Table 4 MAC counts are absent from supplied raw JSON evidence
claims.details: The arithmetic 20.1/18.6≈1.08 is internally consistent, but the requested raw evidence files do not support the MAC counts themselves.

claims.location: Abstract lines 24-27; Section5 lines 369-376; Section6 lines 146-148
claims.paper_text: "$>99%$ of head additions attributed to Dirichlet side-lobe / virtual taps"
claims.details: All supplied attribution cells exceed 99%; the table values round to 99.8%, 99.4%, and 99.6%.

claims.paper_text: "serial receiver floors at BER≈5×10^-2 from SNR≥15 dB with NMSE frozen at -11.3 dB"
claims.evidence_value: No raw key for Serial receiver BER/NMSE; available classical/learned/pcsi NMSE values do not show a -11.3 dB frozen serial NMSE series
claims.details: The raw files expose classical_ber, torch_ref_ber, learned_ber, and pcsi_ber; they do not expose the Serial column used in the paper.

claims.location: Section1 lines 58-65; Section3 theorem lines 176-195; Appendix lines 61-68
claims.paper_text: "bit-exactly on N in {512,1024}; max difference = 0 over 64 seeded test frames per N"
claims.paper_value: N=512/1024; 64 frames per N; max diff 0
claims.evidence_value: No raw verifier output among supplied evidence paths
claims.details: This may be true, but none of the allowed raw evidence files records the verifier output.

claims.paper_text: "measured GPU wall-clock parity at N=1024 (402 ms vs. 416 ms) and +3.9% at N=2048"
claims.evidence_value: learned N=1024 mean_ms=402.3166916333139; torch classical N=1024 mean_ms=416.0120290517807; learned/classical N=2048 delta=3.916%; config fs_factor=2.0
claims.details: The displayed wall-clock numbers round correctly, but the raw runtime config has fs_factor=2.0 while the surrounding paper scope repeatedly says 4B.

claims.paper_text: "5-seed paired-McNemar significance and width-MLP envelope"
claims.evidence_value: headline Table 1 uses 3 evaluation seeds; canonical grid has 3 train seeds x 3 eval seeds; no five-seed McNemar raw aggregate is present
claims.details: The heading says 5-seed, but the supplied raw evidence for the headline reductions is a 3-evaluation-seed pool.

claims.paper_text: "hidden width from 64 to 256 drops BER from 0.0498 to 0.0381 (-23.5%)"
claims.evidence_value: hidden64 best_eval_ber=0.0498046875; hidden256 best_eval_ber=0.038102213541666666; relative=-23.497%
claims.details: Best-eval BERs and relative decrease round as stated.

claims.paper_text: "at SNR=20 dB, K=2/4/8/16 produces -61%/-128%/-337%/-927% gap closed, while learned head closes +81%"
claims.evidence_value: OMP gaps=omp_extended_k2:-61.307%, omp_extended_k4:-128.141%, omp_extended_k8:-336.683%, omp_extended_k16:-927.136%; learned cross-source gap=80.976%
claims.details: The OMP K values match the OMP file; the learned value is not from that file and is computed by cross-source aggregation.

claims.paper_text: "fair P=18 unrolled receiver consumes ≈20.7M MAC, worse than P=10 at 18.6M; tau_h lookup eliminates ≈11%"
claims.evidence_value: No P=18/P=10 MAC or tau_h lookup measurements in runtime_table.json or other supplied raw files
claims.details: The supplied complexity JSON only contains timing/memory rows.

claims.paper_text: "canonical simulator: P=8, tau_spread=10 ms, v~N(2,0.5^2), fc=12 kHz, B=4 kHz, fs=4B, k_leak=2, five virtual taps/path"
claims.paper_value: P=8; tau=10ms; v_mean=2; v_std=0.5; fc=12kHz; B=4kHz; fs=4B; k_leak=2
claims.evidence_value: main BER configs: N=1024, P_paths=8, tau_spread_ms=10.0, v_mean=2.0; OMP config l_max=160, k_max=2; attribution k_leak=2
claims.details: Most canonical physical/config values are present and consistent in the supplied main-result files.

claims.paper_text: "worst-case residual 0.5: two bins ≈41% each; next-nearest ≈4.4%; tail ≈8.3%; p_real≈28"
claims.evidence_value: recall file does not store Dirichlet energy percentages; aggregate p_real can only be inferred approximately from missed/(1-recall), e.g. SNR20 1.3125/(1-0.9529168664198053)=27.876
claims.details: The p_real≈28 cross-check is supported indirectly; the 41/4.4/8.3% Dirichlet energy claims are analytical and absent from raw result files.

claims.paper_text: "empirical support Jaccard between OMP iterations exceeds 0.94 from iteration 2 onwards"
claims.evidence_value: No Jaccard metric appears in supplied JSON/log evidence
claims.details: The support-recall file supports recall, not inter-iteration Jaccard.

claims.paper_text: "support-recall probe confirms ≈95% recall; frames with >=1 missed atom 67--71%"
claims.evidence_value: SNR10: mean_recall=0.9490595887715205, mean_missed=1.4146666666666667, frac_missed=0.712, frames=3000; SNR15: mean_recall=0.9514590322451374, mean_missed=1.3483333333333334, frac_missed=0.6885, frames=6000; SNR20: mean_recall=0.9529168664198053, mean_missed=1.3125, frac_missed=0.67, frames=6000; SNR25: mean_recall=0.9525042078942397, mean_missed=1.32575, frac_missed=0.674, frames=12000
claims.details: Support recall table values match the raw recall_by_snr.json values by standard rounding.

claims.paper_text: "pair encoder 384 params, scorer 657 params, total 1,041 trainable parameters"
claims.evidence_value: No raw JSON/log key for these parameter counts
claims.details: The arithmetic in the paper is internally consistent, but this audit cannot trace it to supplied raw evidence.

claims.paper_text: "M=96 candidates; top-Kadd=4; executed twice; bias patched to +10"
claims.evidence_value: cand_topm=96, refine_rounds=2; no Kadd=4 or bias=+10 field in attribution.json
claims.details: M=96 and two refine rounds are supported; Kadd=4 and the inference bias patch are not recorded in supplied raw evidence.

claims.paper_text: "deployed checkpoint trained on a 27k-frame 4-SNR cache with weights {0.2,0.3,0.3,0.2}"
claims.evidence_value: evaluation config only: frames=350, ckpt=afdm_sp_joint_unrolled/outputs_loop13_4B_train_27k_with_snr25/ckpt_c2rel_force_topk.pt; no training-cache size, epochs, patience, or per-SNR weights in supplied raw evidence
claims.details: The result file names imply retrain27k, but the raw JSON content does not contain the training protocol numbers.
The four best_eval_ber values round to the paper values.

claims.evidence_value: 4B train_log JSON files do not store params; 2B logs show params=675860 for 256 and 2662420 for 512, but no supplied 64/128 parameter counts
claims.details: Partial support exists for 256/512 via 2B logs, but the claimed 4B parameter counts are not fully present in supplied raw evidence.

claims.paper_text: "Attention modules (8-head additive over the 32-D pair descriptor) ... converge to 0.0405 (+6.3%)"
claims.evidence_value: path_f_attn_heads=4; best_eval_ber=0.04178059895833333; relative_vs_I256=9.654%
claims.details: Raw config has 4 attention heads, not 8; raw best BER is 0.0417806, not 0.0405, and the relative penalty is about +9.65%, not +6.3%.

claims.paper_text: "softsort ... tau annealed 1.0->0.05 ... converges to 0.0401 (+5.2%)"
claims.evidence_value: softsort_tau_init=1.0, softsort_tau_final=0.05, best_eval_ber=0.040120442708333336, relative_vs_I256=5.297%
claims.details: Softsort values round to the paper values.

claims.paper_text: "scaling capacity further changes BER only at the third significant digit; representable at 1,041 parameters"
claims.evidence_file: Supplied width train logs; no C2-rel capacity-scaling raw file
claims.evidence_value: Width logs show much larger pure-NN BER differences; no supplied raw evidence for C2-rel capacity-scaling at 1041 params
claims.details: The supplied width-MLP logs do not support this deployed-head capacity statement.

claims.paper_text: "3 train seeds x 3 eval seeds at SNR=20 dB with 600 paired frames per cell"
claims.details: Nine canonical-grid result files are present and each has 600 frames at SNR 20.

claims.paper_text: "cross-train-seed mean±std ... -5.17%±0.57 pp"
claims.evidence_value: per-train-seed pooled deltas=[-5.496183, -4.503817, -5.496183]; mean=-5.165394%, sample_std=0.572943 pp
claims.details: The 3-train-seed pooled mean and sample standard deviation match the claim.

claims.paper_text: "two of three training seeds produce bit-identical paired counts on every cell"
claims.evidence_value: Train seeds 20260507 and 20260509 have identical learned/classical counts for eval seeds 20260423/424/425; 20260508 differs
claims.details: Raw canonical grid counts support this exactly.

claims.paper_text: "Default bit budget 8.19e5 per SNR point; CP 95% CIs; McNemar on n10,n01"
claims.evidence_value: observed high-SNR pooled bits: SNR20=1228800, SNR25=1583104, SNR30=2662400; loop13 SNR25 bits=716800
claims.details: The supplied evaluated bit counts do not equal 8.19e5 for the headline high-SNR cells; the statement may describe a nominal default, not the actual adaptive/pool counts.

claims.paper_text: "training blocks 20260420/421; evaluation frames from {20260423,424,425}"
claims.evidence_value: Evaluation seeds 20260423/424/425 are present in raw configs; no supplied raw file records training blocks 20260420/421
claims.details: Only the eval seed half of the train/eval separation claim is supported by supplied raw files.

claims.paper_text: "3-seed pooled (seeds 20260423/424/425; adaptive frame counts 600/773/1300 at SNR=20/25/30 dB)"
claims.evidence_value: SNR20 frames=600; SNR25 frames=773; SNR30 frames=1300; configs seeds=[20260423, 20260424, 20260423]
claims.details: The caption frame counts and seed set match the three loop12 result files.
The -2.2% delta is traceable to r3 by rounding, but none of the supplied raw BER values match the table absolute BER cells.
The -7.4% delta matches r3 rounding, but the table combines/misstates absolute values relative to supplied raw files.

claims.paper_value: absolute BER and CP CI cells as displayed
claims.details: The displayed high-SNR relative delta matches the pooled files, but the absolute BER and learned CP interval cells do not match the same raw evidence.
The delta and significance portions of the row are supported by the pooled loop12 evidence.

claims.location: Section5 Table 1 row SNR=25 absolute BER/CI cells
claims.paper_value: absolute BER and CP CI cells as displayed
claims.details: The displayed high-SNR relative delta matches the pooled files, but the absolute BER and learned CP interval cells do not match the same raw evidence.
The delta and significance portions of the row are supported by the pooled loop12 evidence.

claims.location: Section5 Table 1 row SNR=30 absolute BER/CI cells
claims.paper_value: absolute BER and CP CI cells as displayed
claims.details: The displayed high-SNR relative delta matches the pooled files, but the absolute BER and learned CP interval cells do not match the same raw evidence.
The delta and significance portions of the row are supported by the pooled loop12 evidence.

claims.location: Section5 lines 106-116; Section6 lines 76-79; Appendix lines 105-113
claims.paper_text: "native-config 16-pilot reproduction matches published Fig. 3 to ±0.2 log-decade at 4/6 SNR cells on 1000 frames"
claims.evidence_file: No supplied qing/cao baseline raw file

claims.location: Section5 Table 2 OMP-extension rows excluding learned head
claims.paper_text: "baseline, OMP-(P+2/4/8/16), oracle_phys BER and GC over 250 frames seed 20260419"
claims.paper_value: all OMP rows except learned head

This row is not from the same 250-frame seed-20260419 source as the OMP rows, despite appearing inside the same same-budget table.

claims.paper_text: "every K>=2 in OMP-(P+K) regresses BER monotonically ... at every SNR cell"
claims.paper_value: every K>=2 regresses at every SNR
claims.evidence_value: At SNR25, baseline=0.000345703125; K2=0.00027734375 and K4=0.000326171875 are lower than baseline, with GC +19.774% and +5.650%
claims.details: The table itself and raw evidence show K=2 and K=4 improve BER at SNR=25, so the universal regression statement is false.

claims.paper_text: "worst case at K=16 giving -927.1% gap-closed at SNR=20 dB"
claims.evidence_value: SNR20 K16 gap_closed=-927.135678%
claims.details: This specific worst-case number rounds correctly.

claims.paper_text: "2B hidden256/512 best-eval BERs 0.0903 and 0.0894"
claims.details: 0.0903 matches the best 2B-256 eval by rounding. For 2B-512, 0.0894 is the last logged eval at 4500, not the best; the best logged eval is 0.085465 at 4000.

claims.paper_text: "2B is 2.4x worse than 4B counterparts (0.0381 and 0.0355)"
claims.details: The 2.4x ratio is supported if the raw best 2B-512 value is used, not the paper-displayed 0.0894.

claims.paper_text: "2B grid has kmax=4 vs kmax=2 at 4B, giving 918 bins versus 510; 4B shrinks grid by 1.8x"
claims.evidence_value: 2B log: l_max=102, k_max=4, Q=918; supplied 4B OMP/iter configs: l_max=160/160, k_max=2/2, Q=800; not 510
claims.details: The 2B 918-bin value is supported, but supplied 4B raw configs and Table simparams use Q=800, not 510; the 1.8x shrink claim is not supported by these files.

claims.paper_text: "convergence over t=1..4; SNR20 t=4->5 classical 8.81->9.07e-4 (+3%), learned 4.51->5.42e-4 (+20%, ≈3σ)"
claims.details: The BER moves and percentages round correctly; the ≈3σ statement is not directly evidenced by the JSON.

claims.paper_text: "support recall table: SNR 10/15/20/25 mean recall, missed atoms, missed-frame fraction, frames"
claims.evidence_value: SNR10: mean_recall=0.9490595887715205, mean_missed=1.4146666666666667, frac_missed=0.712, frames=3000; SNR15: mean_recall=0.9514590322451374, mean_missed=1.3483333333333334, frac_missed=0.6885, frames=6000; SNR20: mean_recall=0.9529168664198053, mean_missed=1.3125, frac_missed=0.67, frames=6000; SNR25: mean_recall=0.9525042078942397, mean_missed=1.32575, frac_missed=0.674, frames=12000
claims.details: All table cells match recall_by_snr.json by standard rounding.

claims.paper_text: "learned head closes 61/81/98% of baseline-to-oracle gap; physical oracle zero on 5.12e5 bits at SNR 20/25"
claims.evidence_value: GC values require loop13 learned BERs combined with OMP baseline/oracle. OMP oracle zero bits at 20/25: frames=250 -> bits=512000
claims.details: The zero-oracle bit budget is supported by the OMP file. The learned-head gap-closed percentages are cross-source, not same-cell evidence.

claims.paper_text: "Top-P physical-support-oracle headroom baseline/oracle_phys cells at 250 frames"
claims.details: Baseline and physical-oracle cells match the OMP-extension file.

claims.evidence_value: learned BERs from loop13 seed 20260425, frames [80, 350, 350]; baseline/oracle from OMP seed 20260419, frames 250
claims.details: Same issue as Table 2: learned-head row is sourced from a different seed/frame-count file than the baseline and physical oracle.

claims.paper_text: "Oracle column: 7.42e-3, 1.17e-4, 0 (censored)"
claims.evidence_value: loop13 pcsi BERs: [0.00360107421875, 0.0, 1.3950892857142857e-06]; OMP file has no PCSI+MMSE oracle column; headroom oracle_support BERs: [0.0194453125, 0.00076953125, 3.7109375e-05]
claims.details: No supplied raw file contains the displayed Oracle column values.

claims.evidence_value: runtime_table.json has no MAC/frame or relative-ratio fields
claims.details: The ratios are internally plausible but cannot be traced to supplied raw evidence.

claims.paper_text: "Wall-clock: NumPy 207/463/1855, Torch 242/416/803, Learned 257/402/834; peak mem 355/368 MB at N=2048"
claims.details: Runtime values round correctly, but the raw runtime config records fs_factor=2.0 while the paper context says results use 4B.

claims.paper_text: "at N=2048 CPU/GPU gap is 2.3x; learned adds at most 31 ms (≈3.8%); peak GPU allocation goes 30->89->368 MB"
claims.evidence_value: CPU/GPU 2048=2.311x; learned delta=31.433ms, 3.916%; learned mem=30/92/368, torch mem=29/89/355
claims.details: The speed and delta claims round acceptably, but the peak-memory sequence 30->89->368 mixes receiver rows; no single receiver has exactly that sequence.

claims.paper_text: "SNR15/20/25 added/frame 2.00; counts main/side/virtual/false; Side+Virt 99.8/99.4/99.6%"
claims.evidence_value: SNR15: added/frame=2.0, counts={'main_lobe_collision': 1, 'dirichlet_sidelobe': 316, 'virtual_tap': 183, 'false_positive': 0}, side+virt=99.800%; SNR20: added/frame=2.004, counts={'main_lobe_collision': 3, 'dirichlet_sidelobe': 303, 'virtual_tap': 195, 'false_positive': 0}, side+virt=99.401%; SNR25: added/frame=2.0, counts={'main_lobe_collision': 0, 'dirichlet_sidelobe': 302, 'virtual_tap': 196, 'false_positive': 2}, side+virt=99.600%
claims.details: Attribution table cells match raw counts. SNR20 added/frame is 2.004, displayed as 2.00 by rounding/truncation.

claims.paper_text: "main-lobe collisions <=3/250 and false positives <=2/250; >99% across all evaluated SNRs"
claims.evidence_value: main counts [1, 3, 0]; false counts [0, 0, 2]; frames=250
claims.details: The count bounds and >99% summary are supported.

claims.paper_text: "side-lobes at ±1 Doppler offsets carrying 5--20% of main-lobe energy"
claims.evidence_file: No supplied raw side-lobe energy distribution file
claims.evidence_value: No per-path side-lobe energy data in supplied JSON/log files
claims.details: This mechanism claim may be analytical, but it is not traceable to raw evidence files.

claims.paper_text: "Five ListNet retrainings produce 64 bit errors / 204800 bits per seed; widening 16->64 changes 1041->13377 params (12.8x), BCE 1.9x tighter, -5.1% paired reduction, McNemar p=0.34"
claims.evidence_file: No supplied outputs_b3_pairh64 or outputs_use_hard_listwise raw files
claims.evidence_value: No evidence files for these ablations were included in the allowed list
claims.details: The TeX comments cite files not provided to the auditor; under the requested evidence boundary this entire ablation paragraph is unsupported.

claims.paper_text: "16-pilot reproduction matches ±0.2 log-decade at 4/6 cells on 1000 frames; Q≈N/3 at N≥1024"
claims.evidence_file: No supplied qing baseline file; supplied 4B configs
claims.evidence_value: No qing baseline evidence. Supplied 4B Q from OMP/iter configs is 800 at N=1024, i.e. Q/N=0.781, not approximately 1/3
claims.details: External reproduction is unverifiable; the Q≈N/3 statement conflicts with supplied 4B Q=800.

claims.paper_text: "Scope fixed at single-antenna, QPSK, rho=0.5, vmax=3 m/s; high-velocity (>5 m/s) out of scope"
claims.evidence_value: rho=0.5 appears in iter config and table text; supplied 2B section/log uses v_max=3.5 in paper text and logs do not contain vmax=3; no raw vmax field in main JSON configs
claims.details: rho is supported; v_max=3 m/s is not present in supplied raw evidence, and Section5 uses v_max=3.5 for the 2B grid claim.

claims.paper_text: "all Monte-Carlo results in the main chapter operate exclusively at fs=4B; fs=2B appears only in a reference scaling illustration"
claims.paper_value: all main Monte-Carlo results exclusively 4B; 2B only reference scaling
claims.evidence_value: Section5 reports a sampling-rate sensitivity experiment using 2B run logs; run logs show fs=8.0 kHz and 2B training/eval values
claims.details: The appendix statement is contradicted by the paper’s own Section5 experiment and the supplied 2B run logs.

claims.paper_text: "SNR=25 learned arm: k=4 bit errors at n≈7.17e5 bits; CI≈[1.52e-6,1.43e-5]"
claims.details: This appendix CI matches loop13 exactly, but it does not reconcile with Table 1, which labels SNR25 as 3-seed pooled with 773 frames and different absolute BER/CI.

claims.paper_text: "SNR=25 Oracle runs to n=8.19e5 bits with k=0; UB≈4.5e-6; same-budget UB≈5.1e-6"
claims.evidence_value: loop12 pooled PCSI SNR25: bits=1583104, errs=0; loop13 SNR25 pcsi_errs=1, bits=716800; OMP oracle_physical bits=512000, errs=0
claims.details: No supplied raw oracle result has k=0 at n=8.19e5 bits; available files have different oracle definitions/counts.

claims.paper_text: "recall and precision are not equal; previous draft claim withdrawn"
claims.evidence_value: raw _meta note says: 'recall = (p_real - missed) / p_real; precision == recall because |OMP|=|oracle|=sparsity'
claims.details: The paper statement may be methodologically correct, but the supplied raw recall JSON metadata explicitly says precision == recall, creating an evidence/documentation conflict.

claims.evidence_value: SNR20 mean_recall=0.9529168664198053, mean_missed=1.3125, ratio=27.876224
claims.details: The aggregate bookkeeping cross-check matches by rounding.

claims.paper_text: "post-processing pass runs in ≈30 s on the 27k-frame 4B cache"
claims.evidence_file: No supplied timing/log file for recall post-processing
claims.evidence_value: No such timing appears in recall_by_snr.json
claims.details: This runtime claim is not supported by supplied evidence.

claims.paper_text: "learned bias≈-8, patch=+10, Δb=+18; gate threshold shifts z_i>8 to z_i>-10"
claims.evidence_file: No supplied raw log/model parameter dump for bias
claims.evidence_value: No bias values in supplied JSON/log files
claims.details: The force-topk bias-patch numerical values are not traceable to supplied raw evidence.
